title: OBI disk stats
description: Disk, file sync, NFS client and pod volume metrics of OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation (OBI)

options.content: Disk, file sync, NFS client and pod volume metrics of OBI's StatsO11y (`metrics.features`: `stats_disk`, `stats_fs_sync`, `stats_nfs`, `stats_disk_pod_volumes`). Totals add up the devices where `obi_disk_stacked` is `false`, so that the I/O of LVM, md RAID and loop devices is not counted twice. See `devdocs/metrics.md` in the OBI repository.

panels.title: IOPS
panels.description: Completed reads and writes per second, per disk and direction.

targets.expr: sum by (obi_ip, system_device, disk_io_direction) (rate(obi_stat_disk_operations_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device", obi_disk_stacked="false"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Bytes read and written per second, per disk and direction.

targets.expr: sum by (obi_ip, system_device, disk_io_direction) (rate(obi_stat_disk_io_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device", obi_disk_stacked="false"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Errors
panels.description: Failed reads and writes per second, per disk and error.

targets.expr: sum by (obi_ip, system_device, error_type) (rate(obi_stat_disk_operations_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device", error_type!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Service time p99
panels.description: 99th percentile of the time requests take in the device, from issue to completion. A LUN shows on its multipath device.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, obi_ip, system_device, disk_io_direction) (rate(obi_stat_disk_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Average queue time
panels.description: Average time that the reads and writes wait before their issue to the device (I/O scheduler). Bio-based volumes (LVM, md RAID, NVMe multipath heads) have none: their service time holds it.

targets.expr: sum by (obi_ip, system_device, disk_io_direction) (rate(obi_stat_disk_queue_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (obi_ip, system_device, disk_io_direction) (rate(obi_stat_disk_operations_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average queue size
panels.description: Reads and writes waiting or in service on average, like iostat's aqu-sz without the flushes and discards: the rate of their queue and service time.

targets.expr: sum by (obi_ip, system_device) (rate(obi_stat_disk_service_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (obi_ip, system_device) (rate(obi_stat_disk_queue_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests in flight
panels.description: Reads and writes that each device is serving (issued to the device, not yet completed), sampled. Requests waiting in the I/O scheduler are not included. A LUN shows on its multipath device: the hidden paths of NVMe native multipath report none.

targets.expr: sum by (obi_ip, system_device, disk_io_direction) (obi_stat_disk_operation_inflight{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device"})

panels.title: Flush time p99
panels.description: 99th percentile of the duration of the cache flushes. A LUN shows on its multipath device.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, obi_ip, system_device) (rate(obi_stat_disk_flush_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Discarded bytes
panels.description: Bytes discarded (TRIM) per second.

targets.expr: sum by (obi_ip, system_device) (rate(obi_stat_disk_discard_io_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device", obi_disk_stacked="false"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Stacked volumes throughput
panels.description: Bytes read and written per second on LVM, md RAID and loop devices. Their I/O is also counted on the disks below them.

targets.expr: sum by (obi_ip, system_device, disk_io_direction) (rate(obi_stat_disk_io_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device", obi_disk_stacked="true"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Throughput by partition
panels.description: Needs the opt-in obi.disk.partition attribute. I/O on the whole disk has no partition.

targets.expr: sum by (obi_ip, system_device, obi_disk_partition) (rate(obi_stat_disk_io_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device", obi_disk_stacked="false", obi_disk_partition!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Stacked volumes and their disks
panels.description: The disks that each LVM, md RAID and loop device is on, with the name of the device mapper volumes in /dev/mapper.

targets.expr: max by (obi_ip, obi_disk_volume_device, obi_disk_volume_name, system_device) (obi_stat_disk_volume_info{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device"} == 1)

panels.title: Top workloads by throughput
panels.description: The workloads that read and write the most on the selected disks.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_owner_name) (rate(obi_stat_disk_io_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device", obi_disk_stacked="false", k8s_owner_name!=""}[$__range])))

panels.title: Average service time per workload
panels.description: Average time of the reads and writes of each workload in the device.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_owner_name, disk_io_direction) (rate(obi_stat_disk_service_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device", obi_disk_stacked="false", k8s_owner_name!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_owner_name, disk_io_direction) (rate(obi_stat_disk_operations_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device", obi_disk_stacked="false", k8s_owner_name!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Unattributed throughput
panels.description: Share of the bytes that no workload is charged with: kernel threads, journal, metadata, and writeback on cgroup v1.

targets.expr: sum(rate(obi_stat_disk_io_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device", obi_disk_stacked="false", k8s_owner_name=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(obi_stat_disk_io_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_device=~"$device", obi_disk_stacked="false"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: File syncs
panels.description: File syncs per second, per call and outcome.

targets.expr: sum by (obi_fs_sync_type, error_type) (rate(obi_stat_fs_sync_duration_seconds_count{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: File sync time p99
panels.description: 99th percentile of the duration of file syncs, per call.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, obi_fs_sync_type) (rate(obi_stat_fs_sync_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: File sync time p99 by filesystem
panels.description: Needs the opt-in system.filesystem.mountpoint attribute.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, obi_ip, system_filesystem_mountpoint) (rate(obi_stat_fs_sync_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", system_filesystem_mountpoint!=""}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Average file sync time per workload
panels.description: Average time of the file syncs of each workload, from the file sync counters.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_owner_name, obi_fs_sync_type) (rate(obi_stat_fs_sync_operation_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", k8s_owner_name!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_owner_name, obi_fs_sync_type) (rate(obi_stat_fs_sync_operations_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", k8s_owner_name!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: NFS RPCs
panels.description: NFS client RPCs per second, per server and procedure.

targets.expr: sum by (server_address, onc_rpc_procedure_name) (rate(obi_stat_nfs_client_procedure_duration_seconds_count{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: NFS RPC time p99
panels.description: 99th percentile of the duration of the NFS client RPCs, per server and procedure.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, server_address, onc_rpc_procedure_name) (rate(obi_stat_nfs_client_procedure_duration_seconds_bucket{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: NFS throughput
panels.description: Bytes read (receive) and written (transmit) per second, per server.

targets.expr: sum by (server_address, network_io_direction) (rate(obi_stat_nfs_client_io_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: NFS RPC errors
panels.description: Failed NFS client RPCs per second, per server, procedure and error.

targets.expr: sum by (server_address, onc_rpc_procedure_name, error_type) (rate(obi_stat_nfs_client_procedure_duration_seconds_count{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", error_type!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Average NFS RPC time per workload
panels.description: Average time of the NFS RPCs of each workload, per server, from the NFS procedure counters.

targets.expr: sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_owner_name, server_address) (rate(obi_stat_nfs_client_procedure_time_seconds_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", k8s_owner_name!=""}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_owner_name, server_address) (rate(obi_stat_nfs_client_procedure_count_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node", k8s_owner_name!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Pods, PersistentVolumeClaims, PersistentVolumes and disks
panels.description: The volumes that pods mount from PersistentVolumeClaims, their PersistentVolumes, the device they are mounted from and the disks it is on.

targets.expr: group by (id, source, target) (label_join(label_replace(label_join(label_replace(label_join(obi_stat_k8s_pod_volume_info{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node"} == 1, "source", "/", "k8s_namespace_name", "k8s_pod_name"), "source", "pod $1", "source", "(.*)"), "target", "/", "k8s_namespace_name", "k8s_persistentvolumeclaim_name"), "target", "pvc $1", "target", "(.*)"), "id", " -> ", "source", "target"))

group by (id, source, target) (label_join(label_replace(label_join(label_replace(label_join(obi_stat_k8s_pod_volume_info{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node"} == 1, "source", "/", "k8s_namespace_name", "k8s_persistentvolumeclaim_name"), "source", "pvc $1", "source", "(.*)"), "target", "/", "k8s_persistentvolume_name"), "target", "pv $1", "target", "(.*)"), "id", " -> ", "source", "target"))

group by (id, source, target) (label_join(label_replace(label_join(label_replace(label_join(obi_stat_k8s_pod_volume_info{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node"} == 1, "source", "/", "k8s_persistentvolume_name"), "source", "pv $1", "source", "(.*)"), "target", "/", "obi_ip", "obi_disk_volume_device"), "target", "device $1", "target", "(.*)"), "id", " -> ", "source", "target"))

group by (id, source, target) (label_join(label_replace(label_join(label_replace(label_join(obi_stat_k8s_pod_volume_info{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node"} == 1, "source", "/", "obi_ip", "obi_disk_volume_device"), "source", "device $1", "source", "(.*)"), "target", "/", "obi_ip", "system_device"), "target", "disk $1", "target", "(.*)"), "id", " -> ", "source", "target"))

panels.title: Pod volume disks and their throughput
panels.description: The disks of the pod volumes, with the bytes read and written on each disk by any workload.

targets.expr: max by (k8s_namespace_name, k8s_pod_name, k8s_persistentvolumeclaim_name, k8s_persistentvolume_name, obi_disk_volume_device, obi_ip, system_device) (obi_stat_k8s_pod_volume_info{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node"} == 1) * on (obi_ip, system_device) group_left sum by (obi_ip, system_device) (rate(obi_stat_disk_io_bytes_total{instance=~"$instance", obi_ip=~"$node"}[5m]))
